articles.summary: California fleet owners: Starting January 2025, HVIP incentives may no longer be available for fleets with 50+ vehicles. Learn how to secure funding for the Xos SV Stepvan and make the transition to zero-emission vehicles while incentives last. Don’t miss out on this final opportunity to reduce cost
articles.title: HVIP Deadline Approaching: Don’t Miss Out on Incentives for Your Zero-Emission Fleet Before 2025
